description: US airport ground stops, delay programs, arrival/departure delays and closures from the FAA NAS Status snapshot (optional airport=SFO). Not for navigation. Not endorsed by the FAA. Price: 10 sats (Lightning) or $0.01 USDC on Base (x402). Sample (illustrative, not live): {"status":"success","endpoint":"airport_delays","data":{"coverage":"us","source":"faa_nas_status","updated":"2026-11-15T20:00:00Z","counts":{"ground_stops":1,"ground_delays":2,"arrival_departure_delays":1,"closures":1,"airports_affected":5,"events":5},"events":[{"airport":"SFO","type":"ground_delay","reason":"wind"}],"airports":["SFO"],"not_for_navigation":true},"metadata":{"cost_sats":10}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay in USDC on Base via x402: sign the 402's x402 requirement (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or `accepts` in the JSON body) and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header; only a 200 is settled.

airport.description: US airport IATA (SFO) or ICAO (KSFO) code. Required for get_travel_airport; optional filter for get_airport_delays.

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_airport_delays
title: Airport delays (10 sats L402 or $0.01 USDC x402)
